objective: Offer searchable online animated GIF reactions in Public Wall, scoped community wall and comments while keeping the existing Connect path and no manual GIF-by-GIF upload requirement.
productionBaselineEvidence: Read-only GitHub production-main source baseline 7b224c39624827282c3cbf003060317045b0a73f inspected 2026-11-23. Current installed/live production OTA fingerprint and EAS GIPHY API key status have not been independently verified; this is DEV only.
chosenApproach: Restore the existing community GIF picker as a shared G-rated GIPHY-backed browser, reuse the already established Connect catalog and secure post/comment flows, add view-local search/debounce/pagination/caching and graceful offline fallback. Do not change RLS, AdsProvider, Expo native modules, or product identity.
selectionRationale: Existing Connect GIPHY integration and post/comment GIF media attachments make reuse safer and smaller than another provider or native package; selecting a GIF must never auto-send a comment or publish a post.
alternativeApproaches: Bulk import and bundle thousands of GIF binary files into APK (rejected: huge app size, storage egress, content licensing and stale selections).
Use deprecated Tenor/provider-native GIF SDK (rejected: provider availability/integration risk and new native runtime/build requirement).
Leave hardcoded 48-GIF comment grid and disabled Wall picker in place (rejected: not searchable or extensive).
preserveBehaviors: Public and scoped community audience and membership authorization, post creation workflow and comment manual Send remain unchanged.
Existing Connect direct-message upload and send authorization remains exactly as before.
AdMob first-view rendering and ad lifecycle, current dashboard navigation, video playback and PTT audio are not touched.
Offline/no-key cases show limited fallback GIFs rather than an empty or crashing interface.
No production OTA, web hosting publish, Play release, database migration, security policy change or native rebuild.
acceptanceChecks: Run both changed Node tests and full Engineering Accountability and performance/compact CI gates on exact head.
Confirm full online library with a real GIPHY API key configured in the intended EAS environment; no key committed to source.
Manually validate Android selecting/searching GIF, private scope attachment, retries and comment manual Send on weak network.
Verify AdMob first-view/fill and dashboard navigation in staging before any consolidated RC or production OTA.
